mentions.name: Manger Animal Manager
mentions.description: This app manages animals and, in its latest release, supports a model of UHF RFID reader to count and identify chickens from up to 15 feet away. It is developed as a hobby project and is available on the App Store.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on an animal management app for the last two years or so. It’s a hobby project so it’s not going very fast. Recently I’ve released a new version with support for one model of a UHF RFID reader. It allows me to count and identify my chickens from up to 15 feet away.
